name: form
title: Form
description: A form wrapper with a submit helper, an error summary that links to invalid fields, and an actions footer.
a11y: A native form; give it an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has several.
The error summary is a role=alert region at the top; each item is a link that moves focus to the invalid control.
Pass each message to its Field too, so the control carries aria-invalid and aria-describedby.
